About.metaDescription: {brand} connects patients in Egypt with trusted dentists and real, bookable appointments.
About.title: About {brand}
About.intro: {brand} is a dental booking platform built for Egypt. We believe that booking a dentist should take a minute, not a week of phone calls.

sections.title: Real availability
sections.body: Clinics publish the exact times they are free. When you see a time on {brand}, it is open, and the moment you book it, it is yours.

sections.title: Simple for patients
sections.body: Search by specialty and city, read the doctor’s profile, and confirm with your mobile number. There are no accounts to create and nothing to pay online.

sections.title: Built with clinics
sections.body: Doctors and clinic staff manage their profile, treatments and schedule from the {brand} dashboard, and see bookings the moment they are made.

sections.title: Arabic first
sections.body: {brand} is available in Arabic and English, with times shown in the clinic’s own timezone.

Contact.metaDescription: Questions about a booking or {brand} for your clinic? Get in touch with the {brand} team.
Contact.title: Contact us
Contact.intro: Questions about a booking, feedback, or interested in {brand} for your clinic? We would love to hear from you.
Contact.clinicsText: {brand} clinic accounts are created by our team. Write to us and we will get your clinic set up, then manage everything from the dashboard.
Contact.patientsText: You can cancel or reschedule on your own from your account, up to two hours before the visit.

Terms.metaDescription: The terms that apply when you use {brand} to find a dentist and book appointments.
Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.intro: These terms explain how you may use the {brand} website and booking service. By using it, you agree to them.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: {brand} lets you find dentists, view the appointment times they publish and book them. {brand} is a booking platform. Treatment is provided by the clinics and doctors, who are responsible for it.

sections.title: Your account
sections.body: You sign in with a mobile number and a one-time code. You are responsible for the number you use and for the accuracy of the details you give. Please book only for yourself.

sections.title: Bookings and cancellations
sections.body: A booking is confirmed immediately when you complete it. You can cancel or reschedule free of charge from your account up to two hours before the appointment. Clinics may cancel an appointment and will let you know. Please cancel if you cannot attend so that the time can go to another patient.

sections.title: Fees
sections.body: Payment is made at the clinic. Fees and prices shown on {brand} are informational and may differ from the clinic’s final charges.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Do not misuse the service, for example by holding times you do not intend to use, using automated tools to book, or giving false information. We may limit the number of upcoming bookings per account and suspend accounts that abuse the service.

sections.title: Changes and contact
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time and will publish the new version on this page. Questions about the terms can be sent to us from the contact page.

Privacy.metaDescription: How {brand} collects, uses and protects your personal data.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what we collect when you use the {brand} website and why.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Your mobile number, your name, the appointments you book (doctor, clinic, time, optional visit type and note) and your language preference. We also keep basic technical logs needed to run and secure the service.

sections.title: How we use it
sections.body: To verify your identity with a one-time code, to book and manage your appointments, to share the booking details with the clinic you chose, and to send confirmations and reminders.

sections.title: Who sees it
sections.body: The clinic and doctor you book with see your name, phone number and appointment details. We do not sell your data and we do not share it with advertisers.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: We use only essential cookies that keep you signed in. They are marked httpOnly, so scripts on the page cannot read them, and they are removed when you sign out.

sections.title: Retention and your rights
sections.body: We keep your data while your account is active and as long as needed to run the service. Under Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law you may ask to access, correct or delete your data by contacting us.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy question or request, write to us from the contact page.
